name: startup-hq
description: A startup team workspace that each person's own AI can run: MCP server + OAuth 2.1, AI-attributed edits, Next.js 16 on Vercel

paragraphs: A workspace for a small startup team that their AIs can run. Tasks, meetings, decisions, a living company brief and a timeline of events, exposed as an MCP server so each person's own Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or agent can do the busywork, on their own subscription, without ever silently overwriting a human.

Built for and used daily by a three-person health-tech startup in an accelerator. Meetings happen in Estonian on Discord, events arrive through WhatsApp groups, and nobody wanted to spend their week copying things between Google Docs and a task list.
Most "AI-powered" tools put one model behind one company's API key. That breaks down for a small team:
features: Everyone already pays for an AI. One person uses Claude, another ChatGPT. Nobody
AI output needs an owner. When an assistant rewrites a task description, the team
The busywork is the input. Transcripts, WhatsApp announcements and forwarded emails
